title: AWS core -- IAM, S3, VPC, cost management
exp: Three concepts underpin everything in AWS: IAM (who can do what), S3 (where data lives), and cost control. Get these wrong and your pipeline breaks, data is exposed, or your bill is 10x expected.
pts: IAM: Users (people), Roles (assumed by services), Policies (JSON listing allowed actions).
Least privilege: grant only what is needed -- s3:GetObject on one specific bucket, not s3:* everywhere.
S3 buckets are globally unique. Objects have a key (path-like string). No real folders.
Same-region S3-to-EMR transfer is free. Cross-region charged per GB.
Spot Instances: spare capacity at 90% discount; reclaimed with 2-minute notice. Safe only for task nodes.
Set a CloudWatch billing alarm immediately when starting an AWS account.
code:
# AWS CLI -- daily toolkit
aws configure   # set credentials, region, output format

aws s3 mb s3://satish-pipeline-unique
aws s3 cp file.csv s3://bucket/prefix/
aws s3 ls s3://bucket/prefix/
aws s3 sync ./data/ s3://bucket/data/ --delete

# IAM policy -- least privilege for EMR reading S3
# {
#   "Version": "2012-10-17",
#   "Statement": [{
#     "Effect": "Allow",
#     "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject","s3:ListBucket"],
#     "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::satish-pipeline-unique",
#                  "arn:aws:s3:::satish-pipeline-unique/*"]
#   }]
# }

# Billing alarm
aws cloudwatch put-metric-alarm \
  --alarm-name "SpendingAlert-20USD" \
  --namespace "AWS/Billing" --metric-name EstimatedCharges \
  --statistic Maximum --period 86400 --threshold 20 \
  --comparison-operator GreaterThanThreshold

viz.cap: Secure pipeline: EMR assumes IAM role, accesses S3 privately via VPC endpoint

qa.q: What is IAM least privilege and why does it matter?
qa.a: Grant only the exact permissions needed -- not broad wildcards. An EMR cluster reading one S3 bucket should have s3:GetObject on that specific bucket ARN, not s3:* on all resources. If the cluster is compromised, the blast radius is limited to only what the role can access. Over-permissioned roles are the most common AWS audit finding.

qa.q: Why should EMR and S3 be in the same region?
qa.a: S3 data transfer between regions is charged per GB (~$0.02/GB). On a petabyte-scale pipeline this adds up quickly. Within the same region, transfer from S3 to EMR is free via a VPC endpoint. Always create EMR clusters in the same region as the S3 buckets they read.
